## 2. Many-body penalty, real track (pair potential fixed)

Hard criteria: every two-bond geometry lies above the dimer-monomer van der Waals complex (worst dE_vdw >= -0.5 kJ/mol, nothing invisible to the counter) and |d lnK| < 0.01 from the term's action on isolated pairs.
